tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Emily wants to talk about help with a project. which part to do. what materials to bring. when to work together.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Emily.

promptBlocks.subject: Can you help?
paragraphs: I am writing about help with a project. which part to do? what materials to bring?
when to work together? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Emily and answer the questions.
